paragraphs: Yosef who honored the Sabbath bought a fish in honor of the Sabbath, found a pearl in its entrails, and sold it for thirteen atticfuls of dinars. An elder met him—see his entry—and told him: ‘Whoever borrows on the Sabbath’s account, the Sabbath repays him’: Kol Kitvei 119a.
